title: Jesus Dies on the Cross
summary: Jesus Dies on the Cross follows a real Bible moment about Jesus' saving love. Jesus gave His life to save sinners. When kids hear about the cross, this lesson keeps the focus on Jesus' love, sacrifice, and forgiveness.

read_it.prompt: Read Luke 23:33-49 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: Jesus was crucified between criminals. Even while suffering, He showed mercy and trusted the Father. That is why Jesus Dies on the Cross is more than a fact to remember; it is a story with a choice to notice.
understand_it: Jesus gave His life to save sinners. Jesus Dies on the Cross also shows that Jesus' saving love changes real life, not only Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus died on the cross to save sinners.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus gave His life to save sinners. Ages 8-11 can follow the story by asking what pressure was present and what faithful response looked like.
teen_explanation: Jesus Dies on the Cross gives teens more than a simple moral. Jesus gave His life to save sinners. The passage asks what faithful action looks like when emotions, pressure, or consequences are real.
key_truths: Jesus gave His life to save sinners.
Jesus Dies on the Cross shows Jesus' saving love through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When kids hear about the cross, this lesson keeps the focus on Jesus' love, sacrifice, and forgiveness.
life_application: When kids hear about the cross, this lesson keeps the focus on Jesus' love, sacrifice, and forgiveness.

quiz_questions.question: What detail should you remember from Jesus Dies on the Cross?
choices: Jesus died because He had no power
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points to On the cross. Remembering that answer helps the story teach salvation through Jesus with a real Bible detail.

quiz_questions.question: Jesus Dies on the Cross is mainly about Jesus' saving love without ignoring the actual Bible story.
quiz_questions.explanation: The theme matters because it grows out of Luke 23:33-49, not from a random moral pasted onto the end.

memory_verse.prompt: Practice Luke 23:46 and listen for how it supports the lesson's salvation theme.

discussion_questions: Which person in Jesus Dies on the Cross had a hard choice to make?
What does Jesus Dies on the Cross show about God, people, or faithful living?
What part of Jesus Dies on the Cross would be hardest for someone your age?

activity.title: Cross and Forgiveness Card
activity.instructions: Draw a cross and write a short thank-you for Jesus' forgiveness.

prayer_prompt: Lord, thank You for Jesus Dies on the Cross. Make Jesus' saving love more than words I say; help it shape what I do.
